goal: Prevent wasted memory by catching struct padding regressions automatically in static analysis
Reorder internal data structure members to reduce memory usage in long-lived or frequent allocations
reviewability: CI is failing, so verify whether the failure is caused by this PR before a deep review
agreement: Concept approval for catching padding regressions automatically (sedited, hodlinator, bartoli, jonatack)
Unaddressed objection: reordering fields harms readability by splitting related fields apart (maflcko)
Prefers opt-in checks per struct for heavily allocated types with measured savings (maflcko)
Suggests keeping guarded members near their mutex and avoiding churn when savings are negligible (jonatack)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it adds an automated static analysis check against struct padding regressions
Preventing memory bloat is useful, but new analyzer checks do not fix build breaks or CI reliability
